page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6e-c12g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor of the x86_64 architecture running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 368.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.67 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, it includes four NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 128 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, requiring external network-attached storage solutions. Network connectivity is supported by a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is relatively weak, as shown by a stress-ng single-core score of 1110.4 and a single-threaded gzip compression rate of 19.36 GB/sec. However, the 48 dedicated physical cores deliver average multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 35520.27 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 147.7 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth is stable, measuring 1975.99 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 98.85 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Redis SET operations perform at an average rate of 33.18 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput reaches 23.02 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance represents a high-density hardware profile tailored for parallel processing workloads rather than single-threaded speed. The lack of bundled local storage means storage costs are externalized, which is a key architectural tradeoff. Given the combination of 48 dedicated cores, 368 GB of RAM, and four NVIDIA V100 GPUs, this server is best suited for GPU-accelerated workloads such as deep learning training, parallel scientific computing, high-performance data processing, and multi-threaded simulation tasks.
